root_cause.text: The `br_nd_send` function in the bridge subsystem fails to validate the option-provided length of Neighbor Discovery (ND) options against the remaining option area size and the expected Ethernet address size before parsing them.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the loop condition was updated to check `i + (ns->opt[i + 1] << 3) > ns_olen` to prevent advancing beyond the option span, and a check `(ns->opt[i + 1] << 3) >= sizeof(struct nd_opt_hdr) + ETH_ALEN` was added to ensure the option payload is large enough before reading the source link-layer address (`ND_OPT_SOURCE_LL_ADDR`).

intent_record.intent_summary: Add bounds validation to IPv6 Neighbor Solicitation option parsing in bridge driver to prevent out-of-bounds reads.
intent_record.what: Added boundary checks in the IPv6 Neighbor Solicitation option parsing loop to verify option lengths against the remaining buffer size and ensure the source link-layer address option is large enough for an Ethernet address.
intent_record.how: This prevents potential out-of-bounds memory reads when processing malformed or truncated IPv6 Neighbor Solicitation packets.

grouping_result.intent: Add bounds validation to IPv6 Neighbor Solicitation option parsing in bridge driver to prevent out-of-bounds reads.

relevance_review.reason: The group's core intent is to add bounds validation to IPv6 Neighbor Solicitation (a type of Neighbor Discovery) option parsing in the bridge driver, which directly addresses the vulnerability root cause of failing to validate ND option lengths in the bridge subsystem.
